Continuing to deliver superior returns

 

✓ EBITDA of $18.6 billion, margin of 44% in 2017

✓ Reshaping the portfolio with divestment proceeds of $2.7 billion in 2017

✓ Investing in high-return growth: $2.5 billion in 2017

-    Silvergrass commissioned, Oyu Tolgoi underground and Amrun on track

✓ Cash returns to shareholders of $9.7 billion declared for 2017

-    Highest ever full year dividend of $5.2 billion
